info.title: arcadia agent IPC
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over NDJSON on the named pipe \\.\pipe\arcadia-agent-<SID>, served by `arcadia.exe --agent`. Supersedes docs/specs/phase-8-estatisticas/contracts/ipc.openrpc.json (v0.10.0). v0.11.0 (phase 9, platforms): Platform gains seedKey, iconPath and gameCount [PLT-014]; platform.add returns created [PLT-016]; new platform.update [PLT-018, PLT-019], platform.setIcon [PLT-011..PLT-013] and platform.delete [PLT-020, PLT-021]; PlatformResult is shared by platform.setEmulator, platform.update and platform.setIcon; new errors PlatformNotFound (-32001) and PlatformInUse (-32013). None of the platform writes sends a notification [PLT-024, IPC-050]. Everything else is unchanged from v0.10.0. Supersedes docs/specs/phase-9-plataformas/contracts/ipc.openrpc.json (v0.11.0). v0.12.0 (phase 10.2, live images): new server-to-client notification media.changed {gameId}, sent by the media queue after a download stores a new image, coalesced per game [IMG-001..IMG-004]; new x-media block. Everything else is unchanged from v0.11.0. Supersedes docs/specs/phase-10-2-imagens-ao-vivo/contracts/ipc.openrpc.json (v0.12.0). v0.13.0 (phase 11, import v2): import.scan takes the optional params platform, titleFrom and recursive [IMV-030, IMV-017, IMV-011]; ImportCandidate gains the optional fields file, extension, discs and discFiles [IMV-024]; new x-import block; ImportCandidate.launchType lists emulator and lastPlayed is an RFC 3339 string (corrections of v0.12.0 divergences). import.apply and everything else are unchanged from v0.12.0. Supersedes docs/specs/phase-11-importacao-v2/contracts/ipc.openrpc.json (v0.13.0). v0.14.0 (phase 12, unified metadata): new methods metadata.search, metadata.apply, metadata.batchStart, metadata.batchStatus, metadata.batchResults, metadata.batchApply, metadata.batchCancel and metadata.batchDiscard [MET-001, MET-030, MET-052..MET-058, MET-064]; new server-to-client notification metadata.batchChanged {batchId, state, done, total, failed} [MET-054]; ImportCandidate gains the optional field searchName [MET-040]; new errors BatchNotFound (-32014), BatchBusy (-32015) and BatchWrongState (-32016); new x-metadata block. scrape.search, scrape.apply and media.queue are obsolete (still served, same behaviour; the image limit of MET-022 now applies to them). Everything else is unchanged from v0.13.0. Supersedes docs/specs/phase-12-metadados-unificados/contracts/ipc.openrpc.json (v0.14.0). v0.15.0 (phase 13, console mode): new server-to-client notification game.closedByHotkey {gameId}, sent after the gamepad combo Select+B closed a game [CON-019]; new methods video.queue, video.queueMissing, video.cancelPending and video.status [VID-005..VID-008]; provider enums gain screenscraper and screenscraperdev [SSC-001]; MediaItem.kind gains video [VID-001]; SessionItem.endReason lists client-no-launch (correction) and closed-by-hotkey [CON-017]; game.launch and game.launchUntracked are refused with SessionActive while a close by the gamepad combo is in progress [CON-031]; new x-console and x-video blocks. Everything else is unchanged from v0.14.0.

x-tracking.description: Agent constants (not configurable yet, not part of the wire), unchanged from v0.5.0 [SES-003..SES-013, DOM-008, PAU-004, PWR-005].

x-library.description: Library constants (not part of the wire) [LIB-001..LIB-002, FTS-005, EDT-001, EDT-003].

x-media.description: Agent constants of the media queue (not part of the wire) [IMG-003].

x-import.description: Agent constants of the folder import (not part of the wire) [IMV-018, IMV-019].

x-metadata.description: Agent and domain constants of the unified metadata search (not part of the wire) [MET-006..MET-011, MET-053..MET-057].

x-console.description: Agent constants of the close-game gamepad combo (not part of the wire) [CON-001, CON-004, CON-010, CON-015, CON-030].

x-video.description: Agent constants of the ScreenScraper video lane (not part of the wire) [VID-002, VID-005, VID-009, VID-012..VID-016].

methods.name: agent.ping
methods.summary: Liveness check [IPC-001]

methods.name: agent.status
methods.summary: Agent identity and uptime [IPC-001, AGT-004]

methods.name: agent.heartbeat
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification every 5 s (no id, no response) [IPC-004]

methods.name: agent.shutdown
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification sent once to every connection when the agent starts an orderly shutdown, and as the first message of any connection accepted while draining (no id, no response). A client that receives it must not restart the agent [EXE-013..EXE-017]. From this point game.launch, game.launchUntracked and game.delete are refused or not applied as described in their methods [AGT-011, SES-033]

params.name: reason
params.description: quit: tray "Sair"; session-end: WM_ENDSESSION; signal: Ctrl+C/SIGTERM; other: the tray loop ended on its own, or Serve ended with an error [EXE-016, EXE-026]

methods.name: game.add
methods.summary: Adds an exe game to the library; the agent writes the row and its game_fts row in the same transaction. Adding the same path again creates another, distinct game (no duplicate check) [IPC-020, IPC-021, GAM-001..GAM-003, FTS-002]. The game goes to the platform of seed key windows, created (Windows, pc) when missing [PLT-027].

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path of an existing regular file ending in .exe (case-insensitive). Stored as filepath.Clean(path).

params.name: title
params.description: Trimmed; absent or empty after trimming means the default title (file name without .exe) [DOM-009, GAM-003]. More than maxGameTitleRunes after trimming is -32602.

methods.name: game.list
methods.summary: Paged, filtered and sorted list of games [IPC-042, IPC-043, LIB-001, LIB-002, FLT-001..FLT-008]. Without params (or {}) it returns the first 200 games of the empty filter ordered by title. Replaces the parameterless v0.5.0 method [IPC-023 is superseded by IPC-042]

params.name: filter
params.description: FilterSpec; absent means the whole library [FLT-008]

params.name: sort
params.description: Default title [LIB-001]

params.name: offset
params.description: Default 0 [LIB-002]

params.name: limit
params.description: Default 200, between 1 and 500 [LIB-002]

methods.name: game.get
methods.summary: Full detail of one game, with genres, developers, publishers and play modes [IPC-044, STO-026]

methods.name: game.update
methods.summary: Edits the metadata of a game as a patch: an absent member is unchanged, null clears only completedAt and year. Works with the game in a session (the session is untouched). Atomic: any invalid member changes nothing. updated_at changes only when a field really changed [IPC-045, IPC-052, EDT-001..EDT-007, STO-028]

params.name: title
params.description: Trimmed; empty or more than maxGameTitleRunes is -32602 (no default here) [EDT-001]

params.name: platformId
params.description: Must be an existing platform id [EDT-002]

params.name: completedAt
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD or null (clears); stored as UTC midnight [EDT-001]

params.name: year
params.description: 1900..2100 or null (clears release_date) [EDT-003]

params.name: developers
params.description: Replaces the set; names reuse the catalog case-insensitively [EDT-004]

params.name: publishers
params.description: Replaces the set [EDT-004]

params.name: genres
params.description: Replaces the set [EDT-004]

params.name: playModes
params.description: Replaces the set; exact names of DOM-014 [EDT-004]

params.name: launchType
params.description: exe or uri [EDT-010]

params.name: launchTarget
params.description: Non-empty, at most 2000 runes; an absolute path for exe [EDT-010]

params.name: launchArgs
params.description: At most 2000 runes, may be empty [EDT-010]

params.name: emulatorId
params.description: Null clears the game emulator; an unknown id is -32001 [EMU-002].

methods.name: game.delete
methods.summary: Removes a game with its sessions and pauses (cascade), its link rows and its game_fts row [DEL-001]. Refused with SessionActive while the game has a session in running, grace or paused, or a tracked launch of it in progress; nothing changes then [DEL-002, DEL-003]. A process started by game.launchUntracked is not affected [DEL-005]

methods.name: game.launch
methods.summary: Launches the game inside a new Job Object and opens a tracked session; returns once the process was resumed. The existence of the game is checked before the active session; an active session is running, grace or paused [SES-031]. If the handler deadline (10 s) expires first, the result is -32603 [IPC-024, IPC-025, SES-001, SES-002, SES-012] A game with launch_type uri opens its URI and waits for the adopted process [RUL-003]. Also refused with SessionActive while a close by the gamepad combo Select+B is in progress (up to closeWaitMs plus the kill); for an untracked game being closed, sessionId is 0 [CON-031].

methods.name: game.launchUntracked
methods.summary: Launches the game as a plain detached process ("Sem contar tempo"): in a Job Object kept by the agent only so the gamepad combo can close it; closing the agent never kills it [CON-011], no play_session row, no session.changed [IPC-033, IPC-034, IPC-035, SES-032..SES-034, ADR 0019] Also refused with SessionActive while a close by the gamepad combo Select+B is in progress (up to closeWaitMs plus the kill); for an untracked game being closed, sessionId is 0 [CON-031].

methods.name: session.current
methods.summary: The active session (running, paused or grace), or null. activeMs/activeSeconds are measured at asOf; they do not advance in paused or grace [IPC-026, IPC-031, IPC-036]

methods.name: session.pause
methods.summary: Explicitly pauses the active session (reason `ui`). Idempotent; refused with SessionNotPausable in grace or without a session [IPC-038, SES-035, SES-037]

methods.name: session.resume
methods.summary: Explicitly resumes a paused session (any pause reason). Idempotent; refused with SessionNotPausable in grace or without a session [IPC-039, SES-036, SES-037]

methods.name: session.list
methods.summary: Sessions of one game, newest first (started_at, then id), including discarded and the open one [IPC-047, STO-027]

params.name: limit
params.description: Default 50, between 1 and 200

methods.name: platform.list
methods.summary: All platforms ordered by name without regard to case, then id [IPC-048, PLT-014].

methods.name: platform.add
methods.summary: Resolves the name (PLT-025: same name without regard to case, then the canonical name of a seed key) and returns that platform with created=false, the category sent being ignored; otherwise creates it (with the seed key and seed category when the name is canonical, PLT-017) and returns created=true [IPC-048, EDT-008, PLT-016].

created.description: false when an existing platform was returned [PLT-016].

methods.name: platform.update
methods.summary: Renames a platform and sets its category [PLT-018, PLT-019]. Games stay by platform_id; seedKey, icon and emulatorId do not change. A name equal (without regard to case) to another platform's is -32602; changing only the case of its own name is accepted.

methods.name: platform.setIcon
methods.summary: Copies an image file into data\media\platforms\<sha256>.<ext> and makes it the icon of the platform; path null returns the platform to its default icon (seed or generic). The previous custom file is deleted unless another platform uses it [PLT-011, PLT-012, PLT-013].

oneOf.description: Absolute path of a PNG or JPEG file of at most 2 MB (by content).

errors.description: Also for a path that is not absolute, does not exist, is a folder, exceeds 2 MB or is not PNG/JPEG; data.reason is one of not-absolute, not-found, not-a-file, too-large, unsupported [PLT-012].

methods.name: platform.delete
methods.summary: Deletes a platform without games, and its custom icon file unless another platform uses it [PLT-020]. A platform with games (hidden ones included) is -32013 and nothing is deleted [PLT-021]. Emulators are never deleted.

methods.name: library.catalog
methods.summary: Options for the editor and the filters: platforms, genre names, company names and the five play modes [IPC-049, STO-030, PLT-014]

methods.name: session.changed
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification (no id, no response) sent to every connection once per session transition [IPC-027, IPC-037]. Library writes never cause it [IPC-050]

methods.name: media.changed
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification (no id, no response) sent to every connection when the media queue stores a new image of a game [IMG-001]. Coalesced per game: the first change is sent at once and opens a window of x-media.mediaChangedWindowMs; changes inside the window are sent once when it ends [IMG-003]. Not sent for failed, cancelled, interrupted or duplicate (same hash) downloads, nor by scrape.apply, media.queue, media.cancel, import.apply, game.delete or platform writes [IMG-002, IPC-050]. Delivery is best effort: a full connection queue drops it (IPC-017); clients reload media lists on reconnect [IMG-010].

methods.name: metadata.batchChanged
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification (no id, no response) sent to every connection while a metadata batch runs in the background: at once when its state changes by itself (searching -> ready, applying -> done), and, for counter-only changes, at most once per x-metadata.progressWindowMs (the first at once, the following folded into one at the end of the window) [MET-054]. Carries only the state and counters, never game data (ADR 0031). Not sent because of metadata.batchStart, batchApply, batchCancel or batchDiscard [IPC-050]. Delivery is best effort: a full connection queue drops it (IPC-017); clients read metadata.batchStatus on reconnect [MET-055].

methods.name: game.closedByHotkey
methods.summary: Server-to-client notification (no id, no response) sent to every connection after the gamepad combo Select+B closed a game: for a tracked session, after its end was written and session.changed was queued; for a game launched untracked, on its own (there is no session) [CON-019]. Carries only the game id (ADR 0031). Not sent when nothing was closed. Delivery is best effort: a full connection queue drops it (IPC-017).

methods.name: import.scan
methods.summary: Reads one import source and returns its candidates without writing anything [IMP-001, IMP-002..IMP-006, IMP-008, IMP-009, IMV-010..IMV-024, IMV-030]. Unreadable sources and missing libraries are warnings, not errors [IMP-008]. For the folder source it reads subfolders, proposes normalized titles, joins the discs of a game into one candidate and returns at most x-import.maxScanResultBytes of candidates, with a warning when it cuts the list [IMV-019].

methods.name: import.apply
methods.summary: Writes the selected candidates, one transaction per game; a failing candidate is skipped and the others go on [IMP-001, IMP-006, IMP-007, IMP-008]. Nothing is launched and no tracked session is created [IMP-009].

methods.name: emulator.list
methods.summary: Lists the emulators, ordered by name without regard to case [EMU-001].

methods.name: emulator.add
methods.summary: Adds an emulator; a name taken without regard to case is -32602 [EMU-001].

methods.name: emulator.update
methods.summary: Changes an emulator; an unknown id is -32001 [EMU-001].

methods.name: emulator.delete
methods.summary: Deletes an emulator; platforms and games keep their rows with the reference cleared; no game is deleted [EMU-002].

methods.name: platform.setEmulator
methods.summary: Sets the default emulator of a platform; null clears it [EMU-002]. Returns the full Platform [PLT-022].

methods.name: provider.keyStatus
methods.summary: Tells whether the key of a provider is registered; never returns the key [MID-001].

methods.name: provider.setKey
methods.summary: Stores the key of a provider in the Credential Manager; IGDB also takes the secret [MID-001].

schema.description: required (1..512) for igdb, screenscraper and screenscraperdev

methods.name: provider.deleteKey
methods.summary: Removes the key of a provider; a missing key is not an error [MID-001].

methods.name: scrape.search
methods.summary: Obsolete (use metadata.search; still served, same behaviour; the image limit of MET-022 applies). Searches a provider for the game and scores each candidate [MID-002].

methods.name: scrape.apply
methods.summary: Obsolete (use metadata.apply; still served, same behaviour; the image limit of MET-022 applies). Applies the metadata of a candidate to the game and queues its images [MID-003, MID-004].

methods.name: metadata.search
methods.summary: Searches every applicable provider at once and returns one scored list with the confidence of the best item [MET-001..MET-009].

methods.name: metadata.apply
methods.summary: Applies the text (priority igdb, steamstore; only empty fields unless replace) and queues the images of one unified candidate, within the per-kind image limit [MET-030..MET-033, MET-021]. No notification of its own; images arrive by media.changed [IMG-001, IPC-050].

methods.name: metadata.batchStart
methods.summary: Starts the background search over games already written (the titles stored are the ones searched). Returns at once; progress comes by metadata.batchChanged. ProviderNoKey when neither IGDB nor SteamGridDB has a key (Steam Store needs none and does not count) [MET-052, MET-053].

methods.name: metadata.batchStatus
methods.summary: The current batch or null. Safety net for dropped notifications and reconnects [MET-055].

methods.name: metadata.batchResults
methods.summary: One page of the rows of a ready or cancelled batch; fewer than limit rows when the page would pass maxResultBytes [MET-057].

methods.name: metadata.batchApply
methods.summary: Accepts the user's choices and applies them in the background; returns at once [MET-064, MET-065].

schema.description: gameId distinct; candidate within the row's list; gameId present in the search.

methods.name: metadata.batchCancel
methods.summary: Cancels a search (keeps the rows already found) or an application (keeps what was applied); no-op in the other states [MET-056, MET-066].

methods.name: metadata.batchDiscard
methods.summary: Frees a ready, cancelled or done batch [MET-058].

methods.name: video.queue
methods.summary: Queues one ScreenScraper video lookup per game (media_job kind video, source screenscraper:lookup), within the limit of one video per game; games already with a video or a queued lookup, or whose platform has no ScreenScraper system, are listed in skipped [VID-002, VID-003, VID-005]. No notification; the video arrives by media.changed.

methods.name: video.queueMissing
methods.summary: Same as video.queue for every game of the platform (or the library) without a video [VID-006].

methods.name: video.cancelPending
methods.summary: Cancels every pending video lookup and interrupts the running one; image jobs are untouched [VID-007].

methods.name: video.status
methods.summary: Counters and lane state of the video queue, with the last quota reported by ScreenScraper [VID-008].

methods.name: media.list
methods.summary: Lists the images of a game with their absolute paths [MID-004, MID-006].

methods.name: media.queue
methods.summary: Obsolete (use metadata.apply; still served, same behaviour; the image limit of MET-022 applies). Queues the images of a provider for a game without changing its metadata [MID-005].

methods.name: media.cancel
methods.summary: Cancels a queued or running download [MID-005].

methods.name: stats.summary
methods.summary: Time per game and per platform in a period, read only [EST-001, EST-003, EST-004, EST-005, EST-006].

methods.name: stats.weekly
methods.summary: Time per week for the last weeks, local time, Monday first, read only [EST-002, EST-006].

dataDir.description: Absolute Root resolved by the agent [DSK-006]

GameStatus.description: Validated in domain (DOM-012); no CHECK in the database (ADR 0012).

PlayModeGroup.description: DOM-014: multi = multi_local or multi_online; coop = coop_local or coop_online; all = any mode, including none

NameList.description: Trimmed, at most 100 runes each (DOM-016); case-insensitive duplicates are removed [EDT-004]

FilterSpec.description: Serializable filter [FLT-001]. Facets with lists match any of their items; the facets are combined with AND [FLT-002]. The same object will back smart playlists (out of scope now). version is required.

text.description: Free text, FTS5 over title, description, developer and publisher; blank means no filter [FTS-005, FLT-007]

emulatorId.description: Default emulator of the platform, null when none (EMU-002).

seedKey.description: Stable key of a seed platform (contracts/seed-platforms.md), null for other platforms. Readers tolerate unknown keys (ADR 0012) and show the generic icon [PLT-009, PLT-010, PLT-014].

iconPath.description: Absolute path of the custom icon inside data\media\platforms, null when the platform uses its default icon [PLT-011, PLT-014].

gameCount.description: Number of games of the platform, hidden ones included [PLT-014, PLT-021].

Game.description: Summary of a game; the item of game.list and the result of game.add [IPC-042, IPC-020]

year.description: From release_date (DOM-013); null when there is no date

totalPlaySeconds.description: Sum of active_seconds of the game's ended sessions; paused time is never included [STO-016]

GameDetail.description: Game plus the fields of the game page [STO-026]. Lists are never null. No media (phase 7).

launchArgs.description: EDT-010: launch arguments, may be empty.

emulatorId.description: The game's own emulator, null to use the platform default (EMU-002).

games.description: Never null; [] when the page is empty [LIB-003]

total.description: Games passing the filter, not only this page [LIB-002]

Session.description: Snapshot of a live session. activeMs and asOf come from the same agent clock reading [IPC-031]. A live display anchors on activeMs and advances it with the client's own monotonic clock in running only [UI-014, UI-022]. Display-only: the recorded time is the agent's.

title.description: Title of the game when the session was opened

state.description: ended/discarded only appear in session.changed [DOM-007, DOM-008, DOM-010]

activeMs.description: Time spent in running up to asOf, in milliseconds, truncated [IPC-031]

asOf.description: RFC 3339 UTC with three fraction digits [IPC-031]

tracking.description: job: process tree in a Job Object; process: game process adopted by the watcher, no Job Object (RUL-005).

SessionItem.description: A session as listed on the game page [STO-027]. Durations of closed sessions come from the agent; the UI only formats them [UI-038].

endedAt.description: null while the session is open

sessionId.description: 0 while the launch is still being prepared, or when only a tracked launch of the game is pending [DEL-002]

pid.description: Process id of the executable started by game.launchUntracked; informational, the agent keeps no state about it [DEL-005]

genres.description: Itens {id, name}, ordenados sem diferenciar maiúsculas (alterado em 2026-11-12: FilterSpec filtra por id)

companies.description: Itens {id, name}, ordenados sem diferenciar maiúsculas (alterado em 2026-11-12)

ImportSource.description: Import origin (IMP-002..IMP-005; file and folder are IMP-004).

platform.description: Empty for folder candidates: chosen at apply (IMP-004). Steam and Epic use Windows (PLT-026); LaunchBox uses the platform name of its XML (PLT-028).

playedSeconds.description: LaunchBox PlayTime (seconds). Null or 0: no session (IMP-007).

lastPlayed.description: UTC instant of the last play (IMP-007).

exists.description: Set by import.scan only: the game is already in the library (IMP-006).

file.description: File and folder sources: path of the main file relative to the chosen folder, with backslashes (the file name for the file source) [IMV-024].

extension.description: Lowercase extension of the main file without the dot, "" when it has none [IMV-024].

discs.description: Number of discs of the game (1 when single) [IMV-021, IMV-024].

discFiles.description: Relative paths of the disc files in disc order; present only when discs >= 2 [IMV-021, IMV-024].

searchName.description: File source only: the name proposed for the metadata search, from the file name or the nearest non-generic parent folder [MET-040, contracts/match-rules.md §5.2]. Absent for the other sources. import.apply accepts and ignores it.

path.description: Folder for folder and launchbox sources; ignored for steam and epic.

platform.description: Platform name chosen for the file and folder sources. Resolved without creating anything (PLT-025 steps 1 and 2): its seed key picks the extensions read (windows = executables, other seed key = console games, none or not found = both) and the exists mark also checks title + platform [IMV-013, IMV-030]. Ignored by steam, epic and launchbox.

titleFrom.description: Folder source only: the proposed title comes from the file name (default) or from the first-level subfolder that holds the file [IMV-017]. Ignored by the other sources.

recursive.description: Folder source only: read the subfolders (up to x-import.maxScanDepth). false reads the first level only [IMV-010, IMV-011]. Absent means true. Ignored by the other sources.

launchboxPath.description: Folder DataPlatforms of LaunchBox, the one the scan read. When set, the images of the LaunchBox candidates are copied (MID-010).

exePath.description: Absolute path of the emulator executable (EMU-001).

PlatformResult.description: Result of platform.setEmulator, platform.update and platform.setIcon.

configured.description: Whether a key is registered. The key itself is never returned (MID-001).

accepted.description: True when the score reaches the threshold (0.80).

path.description: Absolute path of the image in the data folder, media subfolder.

thumbPath.description: Absolute path of the thumbnail, or an empty string. Empty for video.

StatsPeriod.description: Period of the summary, ending now (EST-004).

importedSeconds.description: The part of activeSeconds imported from LaunchBox (EST-005).

lastPlayedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC of the last session start, or an empty string.

start.description: Monday of the week, YYYY-MM-DD, local time.

platform.description: Name of the library platform when it matches; otherwise the canonical name of the first known platform of the candidate; "" when unknown [MET-008].

thumbUrl.description: https URL of a small cover on images.igdb.com, cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com or cdn2.steamgriddb.com; absent otherwise [MET-068].

selected.description: Index in candidates of the chosen item; -1 when confidence is none [MET-061].

candidate.description: Index in the candidates of that game's row [MET-064].

skipped.description: Games of the scope left out: platform without a ScreenScraper system, or video already present or queued.

requestsToday.description: Last value reported by ScreenScraper; absent before the first answer.

InvalidParams.description: Also used for every domain rule that a param breaks (title, year, name, category, FilterSpec, limits) [IPC-043, IPC-052]. For platform.setIcon, data is {reason} with reason in not-absolute, not-found, not-a-file, too-large, unsupported [PLT-012].

PlatformNotFound.description: Same code the agent already uses for an unknown emulator or platform in platform.setEmulator (phase 6b) [PLT-018, PLT-011, PLT-020].

SessionActive.description: Used by game.launch, game.launchUntracked and game.delete (DEL-002); for game.delete data.gameId is the game being removed [DEL-002]

BatchNotFound.description: No batch, or the batchId is not the current one (discarded, replaced or lost with an agent restart) [MET-058].

BatchBusy.description: metadata.batchStart while a batch is searching, ready, cancelled or applying [MET-052].

BatchWrongState.description: A batch method that does not apply to the current state (batch-state-machine.md §2).
